video_title: Stephen A. says the Spurs WOULD NOT be in the Finals if the Thunder were healthy 🤯 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Sam Presti
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Presti defends Shai Gilgeous-Alexander against social media criticism
quotes.excerpt: He's playing against 6 people. He's got 5 defenders and the 6th defender is social media.
quotes.quote: He's playing against 6 people. He's got 5 defenders and the 6th defender is social media. And that's a reality. And he's not going to be the last player that the machine decides to target. But no one's going to handle it gracefully, because when they turn it on somebody else, they're not going to step up there every night and not acknowledge it.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on the Thunder's depth and scoring options
quotes.excerpt: There's something to be said about having not one, but two primary scorers for you.
quotes.quote: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, two-time league MVP, averaged 25 points a game, 8.9 assists. He shot 40% from the field and 28% from three-point range. This is a brother that averaged 30 on better than 50% shooting over the last two or three years, no matter who he's going up against. But there's something to be said about having not one, but two primary scorers for you, in both Jalen Williams and also AJ Mitchell. I know that Cason Wallace can play, but he's no offensive juggernaut. Don't get me started with Lou Dort, he's another linebacker playing football. He's there for defensive purposes, he's not a scorer, and he's a set shooter at that, and not that great at it.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith praises Sam Presti's roster construction
quotes.excerpt: Sam Presti is the best executive in the business. He has proven that.
quotes.quote: Sam Presti is the best executive in the business. He has proven that. And they were the champions last year, they made it to game seven of the conference finals this year, and over the next five, six years, they have 13 first-round picks, 16 second-round picks, a minimum. If anybody could go out and get somebody the likes of Giannis Antetokounmpo, it is them. They have the assets and draft capital and both personnel. Sam Presti did that.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith argues the Thunder would beat the Knicks in the Finals
quotes.excerpt: If Jalen Williams and AJ Mitchell were playing, I don't think the Spurs would be in the Finals.
quotes.quote: If Jalen Williams and AJ Mitchell were playing, I don't think the Spurs would be in the Finals. I think the Oklahoma City Thunder would be playing the New York Knicks in the NBA Finals. As a matter of fact, they'd probably be winning the NBA Finals. And I think anybody that knows basketball knows that.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Brink
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Brink questions Sam Presti's decision to address social media criticism
quotes.excerpt: You're feeding into what social media is saying. You're giving them, letting them know, we hear what you're talking about.
quotes.quote: I understand where Sam Presti is coming from, but I wouldn't even be arguing. You are the two-time reigning MVP. And I do agree with that, if Mitchell and Jalen Williams are playing, we might be having a different conversation. But you're feeding into what social media is saying. You're giving them, letting them know, we hear what you're talking about. But if I'm a reigning two-time MVP, I'm not listening to, oh he's flopping. They're literally doing a flop count on social media.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the prevalence of foul-baiting in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Selling calls is a skill in the NBA. It's been around.
quotes.quote: Sam Presti, he does have a point when it comes to protecting the name of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander. But the problem that I have is, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is not the only person that goes out and draws fouls. I didn't witness Nikola Jokic, he flops, he sell calls. Luka Doncic, sell calls. Stefan Castle, to a certain degree, sell calls. Selling Jalen Brunson, selling calls is a skill in the NBA. It's been around. Sam Presti also went through the thing of Kevin Durant with the swipe through. Remember, he the one started the swipe through and they had to adjust to that.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on the catharsis of telling critics off
quotes.excerpt: There is something cathartic and exhaling that when, you know, it's really good to cuss people out.
quotes.quote: Although 99% of the time, you really should ignore folks and comment, there is something cathartic and exhaling that when, you know, it's really good to cuss people out. I mean, it's it's it really feels good. I mean, I don't I don't think that people realize, when you tell somebody kiss my ass, I mean, it really feels good. You know, it it really does. It's not always a negative. It's not always a negative.
